title: Options
description: Solve options (engine-spec §2 Options; ADR-004: 8 workers, fixed seed).

decision_scenario.description: scenario_id the allocation must satisfy. An id that is not among the scenarios makes the run NEEDS_DATA (UNKNOWN_DECISION_SCENARIO).

time_limit_s.description: Time budget of the whole run in seconds: every CP-SAT call (objective tiers, tie-break, sensitivity) ends within time_limit_s of the start (engine-spec §12.9). The main solve gets at most half of it, split evenly over the objective tiers and the tie-break; the sensitivity solves share the rest. Not money: one of the few fields that may be a non-integer JSON number.

workers.description: CP-SAT num_workers for every solve of the run. The answer does not depend on it: ties are broken deterministically (engine-spec §12.5).

seed.description: CP-SAT random_seed for every solve of the run.

stale_after_days.description: A snapshot older than this many days before txn_date makes the run NEEDS_DATA (STALE_SNAPSHOT).

global_reserve_floor_minor.description: Minimum of the SUM over all cash accounts at every checkpoint; 0 = disabled.
